changelog:
**Build for Jellyfin 12.**

- fix(activity-feed): stop active-streams poll when tab is not visible
 - fix(jellyseerr-search): stop runaway infinite-scroll fetch loop on sparse queries
 - feat(custom-icons): add Jellyfin Helper to supported plugins ([#821](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/821))
 - Details page: file size and audio languages follow the selected version ([#819](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/819))
 - fix(config-page): show why Letterboxd/*arr text mode is locked when Metadata Icons is on
 - fix(letterboxd-links): stop link from permanently failing to (re)appear
 - feat(quality-tags): add 576p resolution tag for PAL DVDs
 - fix(tag-pipeline): re-resolve stale render target instead of dropping the tag
description: A combination of the Jellyfin Enhanced and Jellyfin Elsewhere userscripts, providing a comprehensive set of tweaks and features for Jellyfin.
name: Jellyfin Enhanced
overview: Jellyfin Enhanced and Jellyfin Elsewhere for a better Jellyfin experience.
